algorithm.empty_range: begin equal to end: immediate return at 0x5d498b4, before any stack push; nothing is read or written
algorithm.in_place: the sort rearranges the 16-byte elements inside [begin, end) only; it never reads or writes outside the range on aligned ranges
algorithm.no_lower_bound_check: the backward walk has no check against begin; it terminates because it is entered only when the current pair is greater than or equal to the begin element (first qword greater, or first qwords equal with second qword greater than or equal), and the prefix is sorted, so the walk stops at or before begin and never reads before it
algorithm.order: ascending unsigned lexicographic order on (first qword, second qword); both comparisons are unsigned (jae/jb on the first qword, then jb on the second qword when the first qwords are equal)
algorithm.outer_loop: for each element from the second to the last: hold the current pair, scan backward over the already-sorted prefix, shift right each predecessor strictly greater than the current pair, stop at the first predecessor less than or equal to the current pair, store the current pair in the freed slot
algorithm.single_element: end equal to begin + 0x10: return at 0x5d4989d; nothing is moved
algorithm.sorted_prefix_invariant: after each outer iteration the prefix up to and including the current element is sorted; the single-element prefix is trivially sorted, and each insertion places the current pair in sorted position
algorithm.stability_note: the walk stops at predecessors equal to the current pair instead of shifting them, so equal pairs are never reordered by the walk; because an element carries no identity beyond its two compared qwords, this has no observable effect on the output
